fields.value: Replication Data for:6D Pose Estimation of Pallet Bins for Autonomous Logistics Using a Synthetically Trained Object Detector and FoundationPose

dsDescriptionValue.value:
This dataset is a real-world RGB-D dataset of 284 annotated frames for 6-DoF pose estimation of a pallet bin, collected with an Intel RealSense L515 camera across two indoor environments, lab and hallway (with natural light), three camera heights
  (0.55 m, 1.23 m, 1.92 m), and distances ranging from 1.5 m to 8 m. Each frame provides an RGB image, a 16-bit depth image, a segmentation mask, a 4×4 object-in-camera pose matrix, and visibility statistics. Yaw angle and occlusion are systematically varied to cover a wide range of visibility levels, making the dataset suitable for evaluating pose estimation pipelines under realistic warehouse conditions.
